summary: Restored the two knowledge uses I had dropped from the verify question's account — the election path's voter-only solicitation and the follower campaign trigger with lease-check granularity — so all three entries the account relies on are recorded by exact revision and assertion, alongside the stall witness; the account itself is unchanged. I then rebuilt the shutdown harness from its fixed artifact and added three over-subscribed VerifyLeader cases (320 concurrent calls against 64 verifyCh slots) to test one part of the mechanism explanation: if a stranded future needs a spare channel slot, a caller whose send cannot be accepted should instead be released by the shutdown case. That revision is submitted with two comparisons, one for the over-subscribed cases and one for the standing 128-call strand, and execution is requested. A construction run suggests the protection does not appear — post-shutdown calls were left unanswered in both call counts — but no outcome is claimed until the clean-copy receipt exists. Unfinished: interpreting that receipt and, if the prediction is refuted, correcting the Fact's explanation so it does not attribute the strand to spare capacity.
